source_bound_mechanism: PromptWizard's public mechanism is mutate -> score -> critique -> synthesize, with a second-stage joint optimization of instruction and examples. The accepted candidate is only a Chat-native assignment-strategy reduction; the literal Python plus OpenAI/Azure endpoint route is not accepted.

candidate_implementation_snapshots.contract: Bounded Chat-native mutate/score/critique/synthesize loop with immutable mutation mask, same-scope scoring, inherited terminal-only unique credit, mechanical-failure neutrality and no external executor; it has no durable stage identity and no evidence-readback score gate.
PW-V0 plus stable stage identity, exact resume-before-reselection and evidence-readback score gate.

PW-V1 plus a compact exemplar set derived only from already observed same-scope failures; assignment strategy and failure exemplars may be refined together, but exemplars may not invent performance, broaden scope or alter immutable control fields.

selection_reason: V1 and V2 tie at 12/12. The precommitted tie-break prefers greater source-mechanism fidelity when it adds no dependency/quota/cost/scope ambiguity. V2 preserves PromptWizard's joint instruction/example idea using only evidence-derived same-scope failure exemplars, so it is selected.
critique_complete: The selected variant is guard-complete only as a contract; cross-invocation resume has not yet been naturally observed. Synthesis must bind the restart token to predecessor sequence, frozen authority blobs, decision blob, precommit blob, selected variant, guard table and exemplar IDs so a later invocation cannot silently reseat the optimization state.

Failure exemplars must be references/summaries of already observed same-scope failures. They must never become fabricated success/failure evidence, post-hoc scope changes or extra reward-bearing items.
On restart, exact pending_stage_id must be resumed before any new optimizer-family selection. Any identity/evidence mismatch is a blocker/re-audit condition and awards no credit.
The future synthesized candidate must retain bounded progress and terminal-only credit; the current nonterminal critique checkpoint is not a success outcome and is ineligible for frontier credit.
